how: The opening speaker proposes the logo and recruits, while another person's joining remains a separate act under the revised role.
Recruitment ranges from representing the university to requesting five to ten people for twenty minutes of defence.
Participants revise lettering and borders while fitting the image to neighbouring work and available hands.
A participant reports starting a MIZ at coordinates, and defenders later distinguish the condition of its letters.
A logo reference, coordinates and landmarks make the intended work locatable without independently establishing an agreed pixel template.
Defenders join an uphill fight, assess the letters, encourage each other and finally stop for sleep while hoping the image survives.
The added claim about keepers undoing planned changes cannot be tested without identifying an agreed alteration, the keepers' knowledge and their repair actions.
Participants attribute blue pixels, threatened sabotage and attempted letter conversion to named rivals at differing levels of certainty.
Preserve attribution as an assumption or report where the speaker does not independently identify the placers responsible.
A direct reply restrains proposed flag encroachment with a smaller border justified by competition and insufficient maintenance labour.
Internal border choices and praise for diverting rivals do not document a neighbour agreeing to terms.
The secret proposal to replace a row of a neighbouring flag makes encroachment part of securing the intended border.
The fresh-start range fits rebuilding the same lost spot and considering downward extension without establishing relocation to a distinct site.
Credit for taking and defending a temporary position remains possible after the room reports having no final spot.
Participants mark the ending, report a failed final presence and preserve a modest screenshot taken before sleep.
Preserving a screenshot does not document a decision to continue on another canvas, retain ties or repurpose the effort.
Scarcity and interrupted placing are documented without establishing script or spare-account use or its nonoccurrence elsewhere.
The white-border proposal receives a bare affirmative answer.
Requests address the room's defenders without documenting an appeal to other rooms or exchanged help.
Proximity to other colleges and calls against vandals do not establish a coalition or mutual defence agreement.
Mocking the rival's scrambled picture and inviting laughter at its frustration carry the contest in talk.
Temporary success holding opponents off must remain distinguishable from victory through final survival when the speaker reports no final spot.
Using a flag as a proposed edge does not document a host's permission or authority over a guest work.
Recruitment and defence reports do not document a megathread request, removal rule or canvas sub.
Internal questions about the drawing plan establish neither a representation disclaimer nor a dispute over who can bind placers, even under the broadened definition.
Sharing a pre-sleep screenshot does not document contested historical accounts or requests to clean a shared canvas copy.
The logo call and labour reports do not establish separate host-sub April Fools framing.
An explicit shortage of people constrains simultaneous maintenance and expansion.
The event concepts show school-rival language without independently dating the quarrel before the canvas.
The existing-body range appears narrowly when fellow Tigers are called to represent themselves through the university logo.
An informal design preference and acceptance of a deleted plan cannot establish hidden governance or test the comparative claim about most rooms.
Rival names and retrospective credit for taking a spot do not independently establish an older tie as the motive for the original attack.
Praise for getting rivals to try elsewhere leaves any envoy role, proposal and communication route unspecified.
The build report follows recruitment without explicitly attributing the participant's arrival or placing to the call.
Proposal and call occupy the same passage, leaving a separate start-to-recruitment mechanism unestablished.
Existing letters become objects of defence while construction remains unfinished, fitting the model's range of repair and upkeep.
Defence and internal border planning do not document an ensuing turn to negotiation with neighbours.
Fear of retaliation cannot establish restraint caused by a settled border when no such settlement is documented.
Maintenance strain is reported without documenting a subsequent turn to scripts or spare accounts.
Credit can mark temporary collective defence after loss, without a finished surviving object as its prerequisite.
Credit and screenshot preservation coexist without a passage linking celebration causally to recording.
The record of the attempt is not followed by a documented decision to continue or repurpose the effort.
Too few hands can elicit a smaller border and renewed same-spot recovery rather than requiring withdrawal and relocation.
Allow continuing provisional design through verbal pixel instructions rather than treating a subsequently posted settling template as the necessary route.
A proposal receives a bare affirmative answer, supporting this local response pattern without establishing obligations on silent readers.
Defence calls under strain do not document appeals to other rooms or help sent by them.
Internal border discussion supplies neither an inter-room negotiating channel nor a subsequent exchange of help.
Recruitment and later proposed encroachment establish sequence without showing that the call caused members to turn against rival work.
The reply to proposed encroachment gives competition and maintenance labour as reasons for a smaller border.
The direct answer scales the design to labour rather than documenting a truce or negotiated deal.
Mockery accompanies the contest without identifying a particular attack as the cause of rival-directed talk.
Pressure on defenders is documented without an ensuing coalition or mutual defence arrangement.
Visible recruitment does not document either a flood of posts or a response containing canvas talk.
The bounded after-agreement arrow cannot be tested without a documented agreement and subsequent statement limiting or refusing its authority.
Distinguish reconstructing an image reported gone from repairing still-standing pixels and recruit help for that renewed effort.
Continued recovery depends on available attention, which meetings and screen-sharing interrupt even where participants remain willing to help.
A logo link and internal planning do not document movement into chat or decisions returned from one.
Participants ask about changed lettering and explain an apparent attempt to convert the image into another school's initials.
Wanting the university on the canvas does not document viewers arriving in the room through its image.
Mocking the rival picture as scrambled beside another canvas image supplies a local canvas-specific joke without proving the nickname itself was newly coined.
The opening identifies a proposed black square, and a participant reports starting the lettering at specified coordinates beside named pictures.
A constrained supplementary spot can be considered after encroachment begins but before total loss, so the timing need not precede all damage.
Calling existing Tigers to represent themselves does not document founding a canvas-born room around the mark.
Rival mockery and invitations to laugh do not document an argument about offensive wording or correction of slurs.
Hoping for canvas representation and preserving a screenshot do not document seeking notice from university officials, creators or press.
Retaliation concerns and a labour-based counterproposal discuss practical costs without establishing an argument over the fairness of overwriting.
A defender steps away while outgunned to get sleep, fitting departure under strain without documenting an interpersonal quarrel.
An openly posted secret painting proposal and an invitation to view rivals' posts establish neither concealed communication nor actual infiltration.
Reports of attacks do not identify members harming their own image because they object to canvas posts.
Participants fit placing around sleep and meetings, including a PC absence and screen-sharing that interrupts otherwise willing help.
A PC absence for a meeting does not establish a site fault or attempted technical workaround.
Naming other colleges and fearing a neighbouring flag's retaliation do not document members declaring allegiance to both sides.
